notes.title: A small bug fix
notes.notes: - A small bug was fixed when pausing the game where it was not possible to navigate the pause menu

notes.title: New game mode
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41336365/e210afb7f4ae4b32a92a62337329ee14ac934431.png[/img]

It is now possible to play a versus mode!

In this mode you need to score maximum points by shooting your friends before the helicopter arrives,

Be careful with the elements of the level and especially with the ghost they take points away from you.

The winner will be revealed on a podium at the end of the 10 levels in each biome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41336365/f327bcd417459b2f7f5ac6c0d1816033bee8760c.png[/img]
